name: mikroorm
description: MikroORM with its PostgreSQL driver, through EntityManager.transactional() inside a request context, with defineEntity entities. MG-02 and MG-03 call Migrator.up() and Migrator.down(). The default is one transaction per migration and no advisory lock.

modes.description: MikroORM's defaults: em.transactional(callback) in a RequestContext, allowGlobalContext false. One non-default option is part of a case's form, not of the mode: the TX-02 cases call the nested em.transactional() with { clear: true }, as the reused experiments did, and each result records that form and its reason.
The documented { clear: true } option on nested and inner em.transactional() calls, so that each starts from a clear fork of the EntityManager (reused experiments T1b and T2b).
